description: Reviewed same-meaning, in-order bilingual phrase pairs. Every production visual reveal starts a pair; both prediction holds end at the translated answer onset. Provider alignment is not independent listening.

pairs.en: How can a growing ice face stay flat?
pairs.zh: 生长中的冰晶面，怎样保持平整？

pairs.en: Last time, we followed water through the air
pairs.zh: 上一集，我们跟着水穿过空气

pairs.en: The water arrived from a jumble of directions.
pairs.zh: 水从杂乱的方向来到这里。

pairs.en: The surface kept advancing
pairs.zh: 表面不断向前推进

pairs.en: This time, let's look at how new ice is added.
pairs.zh: 这一次，我们来看看新的冰是怎样加上去的。

pairs.en: Here is a blocky crystal
pairs.zh: 这里是一颗块状晶体

pairs.en: It is a model example, not a measured snow crystal.
pairs.zh: 它是一个模型示例，不是经过测量的雪晶。

pairs.en: Choose one of its flat side faces.
pairs.zh: 选中它一个平坦的侧面。

pairs.en: From this distance it looks smooth.
pairs.zh: 从这个距离看，它很光滑。

pairs.en: We will use a close-up drawing
pairs.zh: 我们会用一幅放大示意图

pairs.en: Keep that selected face in mind
pairs.zh: 记住选中的这个晶面

pairs.en: turn to look along its surface.
pairs.zh: 转过视角，沿着它的表面看。

pairs.en: There is already solid ice below, and air above.
pairs.zh: 下方已经是固态的冰，上方是空气。

pairs.en: Hold the old ice in place.
pairs.zh: 让原有的冰留在原位。

pairs.en: Where can the next bit of ice become part of it?
pairs.zh: 接下来的一点冰，可以在哪里成为它的一部分？

pairs.en: Look along the surface in our drawing.
pairs.zh: 沿着图中的表面看。

pairs.en: It has a flat stretch
pairs.zh: 先是一段平面

pairs.en: Each flat stretch belongs to a molecular layer.
pairs.zh: 每段平面都属于一个分子层。

pairs.en: It is called a terrace.
pairs.zh: 它叫作台面。

pairs.en: The ledge where a layer ends is a step.
pairs.zh: 一层结束处的边沿，就是台阶。

pairs.en: We have made its height enormous
pairs.zh: 我们把它的高度大幅夸大

pairs.en: An arriving molecule can linger on a terrace and leave again.
pairs.zh: 一个到来的分子，可以在台面上停留，然后再次离开。

pairs.en: Beside a step
pairs.zh: 在台阶旁边

pairs.en: making incorporation into the ice easier.
pairs.zh: 因此更容易并入冰中。

pairs.en: These are different opportunities
pairs.zh: 这些位置提供的机会不同

pairs.en: Real surfaces keep exchanging molecules with the air
pairs.zh: 真实表面一直在与空气交换分子

pairs.en: Now watch the ledge move sideways
pairs.zh: 现在看这道边沿怎样向侧面移动

pairs.en: The old ice stays where it was.
pairs.zh: 原有的冰仍留在原处。

pairs.en: Behind the moving ledge
pairs.zh: 在移动的边沿后方

pairs.en: Repeated steps can therefore move a face outward
pairs.zh: 因此，一道又一道台阶可以让晶面向外推进

pairs.en: From far away
pairs.zh: 从远处看

pairs.en: That difference between surfaces changes the shape of the whole crystal.
pairs.zh: 表面之间的这种差别，会改变整颗晶体的形状。

pairs.en: To make the geometry easy to follow
pairs.zh: 为了看清几何关系

pairs.en: It is a teaching shape, not a growth simulation.
pairs.zh: 这是教学图形，不是生长模拟。

pairs.en: Keep the starting material marked
pairs.zh: 标出起始物质

pairs.en: a slow outward speed
pairs.zh: 较慢的速度向外推进

pairs.en: Both kinds add material.
pairs.zh: 两种表面都在增加物质。

pairs.en: For this comparison
pairs.zh: 在这组比较中

pairs.en: their chosen speeds stay fixed.
pairs.zh: 选定的速度保持不变。

pairs.en: Look at a short, fast-moving surface
pairs.zh: 看这段短而移动较快的表面

pairs.en: As every boundary moves outward
pairs.zh: 当所有边界都向外推进时

pairs.en: The slower faces remain.
pairs.zh: 较慢的晶面留了下来。

pairs.en: The faster surface advances
pairs.zh: 较快的表面继续推进

pairs.en: Its added ice has not vanished
pairs.zh: 它增加的冰并没有消失

pairs.en: Slow does not mean stopped.
pairs.zh: 慢，并不等于停止。

pairs.en: In ice, the favored directions come from its own lattice
pairs.zh: 在冰中，优先保留下来的方向源于它自身的晶格

pairs.en: A growing crystal's shape
pairs.zh: 不能仅仅用

pairs.en: Return to one terrace on our ice face.
pairs.zh: 回到冰晶面上的一个台面。

pairs.en: An existing step gives new material an edge to join.
pairs.zh: 已有的台阶，为新物质提供了一道可以加入的边缘。

pairs.en: But suppose this patch has no step nearby.
pairs.zh: 但假设这片区域附近没有台阶

pairs.en: How does the next layer get started?
pairs.zh: 下一层该怎样开始？

pairs.en: A few loosely attached molecules can meet
pairs.zh: 几个松散附着的分子可能相遇

pairs.en: a tiny island of new ice
pairs.zh: 新冰的小岛

pairs.en: Most very small islands break apart again.
pairs.zh: 大多数很小的岛，会再次散开。

pairs.en: Making an island also makes a new edge
pairs.zh: 形成一个岛，也就造出了一圈新边缘

pairs.en: For a small island
pairs.zh: 对于一个小岛

pairs.en: Under the same growing conditions
pairs.zh: 在相同的生长条件下

pairs.en: a sufficiently large island
pairs.zh: 一个足够大的岛

pairs.en: Its edge can then spread
pairs.zh: 它的边缘可以在台面上扩展

pairs.en: The start of a new stable island
pairs.zh: 一个新的稳定小岛开始形成

pairs.en: is called terrace nucleation.
pairs.zh: 这叫作台面成核。

pairs.en: More spare vapor at the surface
pairs.zh: 表面附近有更多可用的多余水汽

pairs.en: so new layers begin more readily.
pairs.zh: 因此新层也更容易开始。

pairs.en: We are following one island to see the process
pairs.zh: 我们跟着一个小岛看清过程

pairs.en: This is also not the only source of steps
pairs.zh: 这也不是台阶的唯一来源

pairs.en: The important point is
pairs.zh: 要点是

pairs.en: Zoom back out to our blocky hexagonal crystal
pairs.zh: 把视野拉回我们的块状六角晶体

pairs.en: Hold the temperature and the vapor supply farther away steady.
pairs.zh: 让温度和远处的水汽供给保持稳定。

pairs.en: Growing ice depletes the air beside it.
pairs.zh: 正在生长的冰，会耗减旁边空气里的水汽。

pairs.en: In this example
pairs.zh: 在这个例子中

pairs.en: the projecting corners have slightly more spare vapor
pairs.zh: 突出角部附近可用的多余水汽

pairs.en: Compare those locations before adding any new mechanism.
pairs.zh: 先比较这些位置，再加入新的机制。

pairs.en: More vapor is available near a corner
pairs.zh: 角部附近可用的水汽较多

pairs.en: less is available near the middle.
pairs.zh: 中部附近则较少。

pairs.en: If the surface responded equally everywhere
pairs.zh: 如果表面各处的响应相同

pairs.en: The middle would be left behind
pairs.zh: 中部会落在后面

pairs.en: So why does the difference not keep getting larger?
pairs.zh: 那么，为什么差异没有一直扩大？

pairs.en: The surface response does not have to stay equal.
pairs.zh: 表面各处的响应，并不一定始终相同。

pairs.en: The steps we just met can change it.
pairs.zh: 刚才认识的台阶，就能改变它。

pairs.en: Keep this particular supply pattern in view
pairs.zh: 请记住眼前这一种供给分布

pairs.en: it is a blocky-crystal example
pairs.zh: 它是块状晶体的例子

pairs.en: Stay with that same face
pairs.zh: 继续看同一个晶面

pairs.en: In the mechanism described by snow crystal physicist Kenneth Libbrecht
pairs.zh: 在雪晶物理学家肯尼思·利布雷希特描述的机制中

pairs.en: new layers tend to start near the corners
pairs.zh: 新层往往在角部附近开始形成

pairs.en: Follow one of their step edges
pairs.zh: 跟着其中一道台阶边缘

pairs.en: Near the corner
pairs.zh: 在角部附近

pairs.en: Farther inward
pairs.zh: 再向内一些

pairs.en: Now add successive steps.
pairs.zh: 现在接连加入几道台阶。

pairs.en: They start quickly
pairs.zh: 它们出发时较快

pairs.en: so the step edges become more closely spaced there.
pairs.zh: 因此台阶边缘在那里排得更密。

pairs.en: The middle gains more step edge in the same amount of surface.
pairs.zh: 同样大小的表面区域里，中部拥有了更多台阶边缘。

pairs.en: Those moving lines mark the edges of growing layers.
pairs.zh: 这些移动的线，标记的是正在生长的层的边缘。

pairs.en: They are not pieces of old ice sliding along the face
pairs.zh: 它们不是沿着晶面滑动的旧冰

pairs.en: and they are not a stream of water molecules
pairs.zh: 也不是从角部一路流到中心的水分子

pairs.en: New material joins locally as each step advances.
pairs.zh: 每道台阶推进时，新的物质都在当地加入。

pairs.en: The changing spacing gives the middle more opportunities
pairs.zh: 间距的变化，让中部有更多机会

pairs.en: We now have two parts of the same face to compare.
pairs.zh: 现在，我们可以比较同一个晶面的两个位置。

pairs.en: The corner has more spare vapor
pairs.zh: 角部旁边的多余水汽较多

pairs.en: The middle has less.
pairs.zh: 中部较少。

pairs.en: Keep the temperature fixed
pairs.zh: 温度保持不变

pairs.en: they became more closely spaced toward the middle.
pairs.zh: 它们越靠近中部，间距就越小。

pairs.en: What could help the middle keep up?
pairs.zh: 什么能帮助中部跟上？

pairs.en: More closely spaced steps give the middle more places to add ice.
pairs.zh: 排得更密的台阶，给了中部更多增加新冰的位置。

pairs.en: Each patch's advance depends
pairs.zh: 每片区域推进得多快

pairs.en: In this steady-growth picture
pairs.zh: 在这幅稳定生长的图景里

pairs.en: At the corners the pairing goes the other way
pairs.zh: 角部的搭配则相反

pairs.en: Now follow the whole face as it advances
pairs.zh: 现在，参照原来的轮廓，跟着整个晶面向前推进

pairs.en: The two effects can balance
pairs.zh: 这两种效应可以相互平衡

pairs.en: It has not become perfectly flat at the molecular scale.
pairs.zh: 在分子尺度上，它并没有变得绝对平坦。

pairs.en: It keeps a very shallow inward dish
pairs.zh: 它仍保留着极浅的内凹

pairs.en: Seen at the scale of the crystal
pairs.zh: 放回整颗晶体的尺度

pairs.en: The balance can correct a small change.
pairs.zh: 这种平衡可以纠正小的变化。

pairs.en: First imagine the face is a little too flat
pairs.zh: 先想象一下：对眼前的条件来说，晶面稍微太平了

pairs.en: The corners get ahead
pairs.zh: 角部会领先

pairs.en: As steps crowd toward the middle
pairs.zh: 台阶朝中部挤密时

pairs.en: Now imagine the face is too deeply dished.
pairs.zh: 现在再想象，晶面凹得太深了。

pairs.en: The middle can advance faster and catch up
pairs.zh: 中部可以推进得更快，追上来

pairs.en: That is a negative feedback
pairs.zh: 这就是负反馈

pairs.en: Nothing measures the face with a ruler.
pairs.zh: 没有什么东西在拿尺子测量晶面。

pairs.en: Local supply and local surface response produce the correction.
pairs.zh: 局部供给和局部表面响应，共同产生这种调整。

pairs.en: The stable shape depends on the crystal's size
pairs.zh: 稳定的形状取决于晶体的大小

pairs.en: it is not one universal curve.
pairs.zh: 并不存在一条通用曲线。

pairs.en: And the correction has a limit.
pairs.zh: 而这种调整也有它的限度。

pairs.en: A surface cannot keep increasing its effective growth response without bound.
pairs.zh: 表面不能无限增强它的有效生长响应。

pairs.en: If the middle can no longer increase its response enough
pairs.zh: 如果中部再也无法把响应提高到足以跟上角部

pairs.en: Faster growth or a larger crystal can make branching more likely
pairs.zh: 生长更快，或者晶体更大，都可能让分枝更容易发生

pairs.en: but there is no single size or vapor level
pairs.zh: 但并不存在一个统一的尺寸或水汽水平

pairs.en: Let's bring the story back to one face.
pairs.zh: 把故事带回一个晶面。

pairs.en: A step gives arriving water more places to join.
pairs.zh: 台阶给到来的水提供了更多加入的位置。

pairs.en: As the step spreads
pairs.zh: 随着台阶扩展

pairs.en: Across the whole crystal
pairs.zh: 放眼整颗晶体

pairs.en: Starting and moving new steps keeps those faces growing.
pairs.zh: 新台阶的形成和移动，让这些晶面持续生长。

pairs.en: On our blocky crystal
pairs.zh: 在我们的块状晶体上

pairs.en: Steps move inward and crowd toward the middle
pairs.zh: 台阶向内移动，在中部逐渐变密

pairs.en: where more attachment opportunities can compensate for less supply.
pairs.zh: 更多的附着机会，可以补偿较少的供给。

pairs.en: A tiny inward curve helps the face advance nearly evenly.
pairs.zh: 一点向内的弯曲，帮助晶面近乎均匀地向前推进。

pairs.en: That is how a growing face can look flat
pairs.zh: 因此，生长中的晶面可以看起来平坦

pairs.en: But what happens once that correction is no longer enough?
pairs.zh: 但如果这种调整不再够用，会发生什么？

pairs.en: Keep one corner in view.
pairs.zh: 把一个角部留在视野中。

pairs.en: If it begins to get ahead
pairs.zh: 如果它开始领先

pairs.en: In the next episode
pairs.zh: 下一集

predictions.answerEn: More closely spaced steps give the middle more places to add ice.
predictions.answerZh: 排得更密的台阶，给了中部更多增加新冰的位置。
